Name: CP - Expressive Elliott
Author: Syraye
Description:
Just another portrait replacement mod for Elliott.  

As I was working on some scenes for my Immersive Elliott mod, I realized Elliott needed a few more expressions, and thus, this portrait sheet was born! I based his design off the original concept art, but added my own flair. If you like it let me know! I might make more in this style.

Manifest.Name: Expressively Elliott (CP) Portrait
Manifest.Description: Portrait replacement sheet for Elliott based off the original concept art. Featuring new expressions!
Manifest.Author: Syraye

Downloads.Description: Just drop into the Mods folder. If using other portrait replacements for Elliott, load this last to overwrite it. Alternatively, you can override the other mod's Elliott.png file.
